bindings.caption: QDs and phospholipids are mixed in chloroform. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Chloroform is evaporated to form a film. temperature: 30 °C. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Film is heated to facilitate encapsulation. temperature: 80 °C. duration: 1 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Water is added to solubilize QD micelles. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

QD micelles are isolated from aggregates. duration: 10 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Additional phospholipids are removed. duration: 25 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: flask. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
